mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% per annum triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs and unemployment below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that drives corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) spurs consumer spending and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without additional regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend over the past 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units and retail sales above 500,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 2.5%) trigger anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
